newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Marcopper to spin-off mining operations.
newsitem.headline: Marcopper to spin-off mining operations.

text.p: Marcopper Mining Corp said on Wednesday its board of directors has approved the spin-off of its mining operations to a new, wholly-owned subsidiary.
The board agreed to setting up Newco to takeover the mining operations of Marcopper, a company statement to the Philippine Stock Exchange said.
The Marcopper board also approved the change in the company's primary purpose to a holding company from a mining firm.
Marcopper's corporate name will also be changed to San Antonio Industrial Holdings Inc.
Newco's initial subscribed and paid-up capital will be paid by Marcopper through a deed of transfer of all the assets and liabilities of its mining operations in exchange for Newco shares.
The company said the board also agreed to cut the number of directors to seven from eight.
Marcopper closed down its copper ore mill in the central Philippines in March 1996 after its tailings leaked into and polluted a nearby river.
